stem:
This cause-and-effect diagram describes events in Southwest Asia.

Which statement correctly replaces the question mark in this diagram?

options.label: A
options.text: An allied coalition fought against Iraq in the Persian Gulf War.

options.label: B
options.text: Iraqi soldiers took hostages at the U.S. Embassy in Iraq.

options.label: C
options.text: Iraq was divided into a democratic country and a communist country.

options.label: D
options.text: An allied coalition voted to remove Iraq from the United Nations.

visual_elements: Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein ordered the invasion of Kuwait in 1990.
The UN Security Council ordered Iraq to withdraw from Kuwait.
